added.name: FluxCap
added.long_description: FluxCap is a Deep Legal Tech platform built to think like a lawyer, bringing expert-level legal reasoning to complex litigation and helping ambitious lawyers win cases on the merits, not resources. Its platform, powered by its Advanced Legal Reasoning Architecture (ALRA), helps lawyers reason through the law, evidence, and strategy of a case as a whole. FluxCap was founded by Jonathan Kanter, former U.S. Assistant Attorney General for Antitrust, and Doha Mekki, former Acting Assistant Attorney General, and built by former Justice Department lawyers and Palantir engineers working side by side. The company is backed by YCombinator, with participation from Bloomberg Beta, Deep Work Capital, Coalition Operators, and Omidyar Network. FluxCap built its litigation platform to start with Antitrust and will soon expand into other sectors. FluxCap is currently being used to support live, complex cases.
added.one_liner: FluxCap is Deep Legal Tech built to think like a lawyer

added.name: Foreshadow Industries

long_description.before:
Massdriver is an internal developer platform and platform orchestrator. Platform teams publish the Terraform, OpenTofu, and Helm they already write to a catalog; developers and AI agents provision from it with policy enforced before every deploy. Self-hosted or managed.

Platform teams encode their security, compliance, and cost requirements into the modules once. Developers and AI agents pick from the catalog, policy runs before anything is created, and every deploy is recorded with who proposed and who approved it.

Massdriver generates an ephemeral pipeline per deploy, so there are no standing CI/CD pipelines to maintain. Run it self-hosted, on-prem, or in your cloud.
long_description.after: Massdriver is a platform orchestrator for governed infrastructure change and an internal developer platform for teams using Terraform, OpenTofu, and Helm. Platform teams publish the infrastructure they already maintain as approved capabilities with typed inputs and dependencies. Developers, CI, automation, and AI agents request changes through the same governed path, where Massdriver applies policy, permissions, and approvals before executing with platform-held credentials. Every deploy records who proposed and approved the change, and Massdriver creates an ephemeral execution workflow per deployment rather than requiring teams to maintain standing infrastructure pipelines. Massdriver can be managed or self-hosted in the customer's cloud or security boundary.

one_liner.before: Internal developer platform for Terraform, OpenTofu and Helm
one_liner.after: Platform orchestrator for governed infrastructure change

long_description.before:
Wideframe is an AI coworker for video editors. It automates the searching, labeling, organizing, and sequencing of footage so editors can ship videos faster.

Why is this important? Well, it turns out that editors spend 3x more time preparing footage than actually editing.

One agency said we will save their editors 10 hours per week. Another organized an entire documentary worth of footage in hours rather than weeks. He had 2,500+ videos, 500+ audio clips, across >2.5 TB of files and our agent handled them effortlessly.

Users link footage to Wideframe and then our Agent acts like an Assistant Editor to handle work like searching, labeling, organizing, and sequencing footage. Wideframe works with footage across local filesystems and cloud providers. We also supports Adobe Premiere Pro (.prproj) roundtrip. Our robust integrations are important so that Wideframe can work with source footage all the way through to delivering Premiere Pro projects to editors.
long_description.after:
We help video teams deliver better edits, faster.

Video editing is going the way of software engineering. It’s becoming AI-native, and that shift is elevating today’s editors into creative strategists, producers, and orchestrators of AI agents.

Our co-founder and CEO wrote about this shift here: https://danielpearson.substack.com/p/how-ai-took-my-job

We build for teams, not solo creators. Our customers produce episodic content for TV and YouTube, juggle multiple client deadlines, or run high-volume commercial content inside brands.

For our customers, videos are never done. They’re just due. We help with the work in between.

one_liner.before: AI coworker for video editors to ship more video faster
one_liner.after: We help video teams deliver better edits, faster.

long_description.before: Speko is a router for voice models: one API key, and your voice agent runs on the speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models we measured as best for your language and use case. The measurements are public at benchmarks.speko.ai: we test new models the day they ship and re-route when the numbers change, so you rewrite nothing. We ran this bake-off by hand for four years at previous company, shipping production voice for Fortune 500s.
long_description.after: Speko is a voice agent platform for business phone calls: teams build, test, run and monitor AI phone agents for scripted calls such as interviews, candidate screens and intake. Use cases include hiring screens, clinic intake, customer support and appointment booking. Simulated callers test each draft, and an AI judge reviews each call. Free credit on signup, no sales call needed. Speko is audited for SOC 2 Type 2 and compliant with HIPAA and GDPR. Speko is based in San Francisco (YC S26).

one_liner.before: OpenRouter for Voice AI: one API, every call on the best speech model
one_liner.after: AI Phone Agents for Business Calls

long_description.before: Alkera is a data engineering/analysis/science agent that works in your IDE or CLI. If you’re tired of agents that produce false, or even dangerous, reports about your data, then Alkera is for you. Our agent is equipped with your data’s history and lineage, your team’s knowledge, and tailored plugins for data apps such as Snowflake and dbt. Simply install and connect your services to begin doing trusted agentic data work. We also offer VPC & on-prem deployment options for when data can't leave your boundary.
long_description.after: Alkera is the AI platform for enterprise data teams, especially in regulated industries where trust isn't optional, with governed agents that handle data engineering, analytics, and data science across a company's entire data stack. Our agents connect to every data tool and application a company runs, from legacy to modern, trace end-to-end lineage across all of them, and operate under strict permissions with full observability into everything they touch, while automatically maintaining a shared team context that includes a knowledge base and semantic layer. Our research division backs the product and services with proprietary techniques, including training models on each company's own data, so enterprises own AI efficiently tuned to their data work.

one_liner.before: Reliable and safe data engineering and data science agents
one_liner.after: AI platform for enterprise data teams

long_description.before:
Latent is a control layer for AI, built on interpretability. It reads signals inside a model as it works and checks every answer and agent action in milliseconds. Then it lets the output through, holds it, re-asks a stronger model, or sends it to review with the reason attached.

Reading the model is far cheaper than running a second LLM, so it can check every step. Latent stops 99% of rule-breaking agents before they act, against 69% for a frontier LLM judge.

It works with self-hosted and API models like GPT, Claude, and Gemini, runs hosted or in your own cloud, and calibrates to your traffic with every review.
long_description.after:
Latent automates post-training for LLMs. It reads signals inside a model as it works and labels every answer and agent step in milliseconds, so teams improve their models on their own production traffic instead of paying for human labeling.

The same signal works in real time. Latent lets an output through, holds it, re-asks a stronger model, or sends it to review with the reason attached. Reading the model is over 660x cheaper than running an LLM judge, so it can check everything. One voice AI company using Latent finds 98% of its agent’s failures by reviewing only the riskiest 43% of answers, and in testing Latent stopped 99% of rule-breaking agents before they acted, against 69% for a frontier LLM judge.

It works with self-hosted and API models like GPT, Claude, and Gemini, runs hosted or fully in your own cloud, and installs with one line of code.

one_liner.before: Stop AI agent mistakes by reading the model’s mind

long_description.before:
Graphide CI runs your CI 10-20× faster than GitHub runners on enterprise deployments, and our 24/7 agents optimize the CI itself, not just the machines. For teams with big CI bills that haven't been optimized, we cut costs 70%+ and take over the ongoing work of optimizing CI, so you can focus on your product.

We're faster and cheaper because we own both the hardware and the optimizations and configs that run on it, which lets us do what owning only one could not. A graph of the codebase runs only the tests each change can reach, and we run your tests in parallel, so your CI is limited only by the length of your longest test. Our agents then tune machines, caches and test splits as you add more tests and code over time. We also patch the tests themselves, fixing flakes and adding our own libraries so they run faster and more reliably.

Coding agents now write more code than teams can check, making verification the new bottleneck. CI is where we start, but we also cover the rest of the verification stack. Our PR review agent runs the old and new code in live environments, finding bugs and proving them by writing tests (50% more bugs found than Greptile on our benchmarks, with 35% fewer false positives). Our visualizer shows data flows and graph-based diffs so you can understand a PR in seconds.

long_description.before:
Large health systems already earn revenue licensing de-identified clinical data to pharma. Most providers can't, because their data is scattered across EHRs, clinical notes, wearables and surveys, and they don't have the team to make it usable.

Sutrix does the work for them. We deploy inside the provider's own environment, pull records from every source, link and reconcile them, de-identify them, and package research-ready datasets for pharma and AI labs.

Our engine already runs for paying research teams and we are now expanding into health systems.

We're brothers who've built together for 4 years. We first solved this problem doing forward-deployed work at HSS, where we built an injury surveillance system now used by 700+ teams. Ritvik's clinical research at HSS and Emory showed us every provider has the same bottleneck. Supratik previously founded and exited an AI security company backed by a16z Speedrun, and built production AI agents at Amazon.
long_description.after:
Sutrix helps healthcare providers prepare and license clinical data to pharma companies and AI labs. We've reached 20k mrr working with research teams to prepare patient data and are now using that same software to turn years of fragmented medical records into longitudinal datasets that capture patient journeys, treatment decisions and outcomes.

We’re brothers who built HSS’s injury surveillance system, used by 700+ teams. Ritvik is a published clinical researcher at HSS and Emory. Supratik built production AI agents at Amazon and previously founded an AI security company backed by a16z Speedrun.

one_liner.after: Transforming how healthcare providers monetize clinical data.
